name: instance-override-arms-table
title: tests(instance): pin override arms for workdir, environment, selective, catalog
body:
### What
Table-driven pin of four `apply_override_inner` arms (workdir, environment, syscalls.control=selective, catalog): values apply, catalog is version-pinned fail-closed, unknown and derived keys rejected.

### Why it matters
Each match arm is an operator-facing config gate; deleting any arm silently ignores overrides or admits a mismatched contract catalog. Existing tests cover id/vcpus/hostname but not these four arms.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| delete `instance.workdir` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `instance.environment` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `b"selective"` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `contract.catalog` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib override_arms_apply`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: vfs-decode-boundary-exact
title: tests(vfs): pin decode_record exact path/link bounds and overflow rejection
body:
### What
Pins `decode_record` length gates: exact MAX_PATH/MAX_LINK fit decodes, one-past-MAX_LINK and zero-length path are rejected at index load.

### Why it matters
Decode gates guard every record read; relaxing `>` to `>=` rejects valid exact-fit images, while `==` admits oversized links that later slice out of bounds. Existing tests pin encode-side and path-overflow only, not decode-side exact fit or link overflow.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `link_len > MAX_LINK` -> `>=` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `path_len > MAX_PATH` -> `==` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-vfs --lib decode_record_accepts_exact`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: oci-select-manifest-platform
title: tests(oci): pin select_manifest linux/amd64/no-variant platform gate
body:
### What
Pins `select_manifest`: only linux/amd64 with empty variant is selected; wrong OS, wrong arch, or non-empty variant are rejected.

### Why it matters
Platform selection gates which manifest runs; flipping `&&` to `||` admits foreign-OS or variant manifests into the amd64 slot — a confinement-relevant mis-selection. No existing test exercises select_manifest.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| first `&&` -> `||` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| second `&&` -> `||` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-oci --lib select_manifest_requires`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.
